title: Ordered-column elimination transform
description:
Extend dense $\mathrm{GF}(2)$ row reduction with an ordered-column preference and the row-operation transform needed by matrix and syndrome callers.

## Background

`gf2_core::alg::rref` exposes directional pivoting but cannot consume an explicit preference permutation or apply the same row operations to a right-hand side. The reusable primitive remains independent of coding and LLR policy.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Accepts a complete ordered column preference and returns the reduced matrix, selected independent columns in preference order, rank, and applied row transform.
- [hard] REQ-02: Applies the returned transform to a conforming right-hand side so $\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b}$ is equivalent to $(\mathbf{U}\mathbf{A})\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{U}\mathbf{b}$.
- [hard] REQ-03: Handles rank-deficient, empty, and rectangular matrices deterministically and identifies inconsistent transformed right-hand sides outside the reachable row space.
- [hard] REQ-04: Rejects malformed preference permutations and right-hand-side dimensions through documented public errors.
- [hard] REQ-05: Matches existing RREF rank and row-space semantics under natural and reversed column orders.

title: Syndrome-domain OSD adapter
description:
Provide parity-check-domain OSD correction for a failed hard word using posterior reliability magnitudes.

## Background

For parity-check matrix $\mathbf{H}$ and failed hard word $\mathbf{y}$, the adapter forms $\mathbf{s}=\mathbf{H}\mathbf{y}^{\mathsf T}$ and searches for $\mathbf{e}$ satisfying $\mathbf{H}\mathbf{e}^{\mathsf T}=\mathbf{s}$. Elimination prefers columns in ascending posterior magnitude so pivots align with the least reliable coordinates; for rank $r$, error patterns enumerate the $n-r$ free coordinates up to order $m$, each completed uniquely by pivot back-substitution, with order 0 the all-zero free pattern. Candidate cost is the magnitude-only sum of flipped posterior LLRs, ties break deterministically in enumeration order, and the returned word is $\mathbf{y}\oplus\mathbf{e}$ for the lowest-cost valid tested candidate. The result equals the global order-$m$ cost minimum only in uncapped exhaustive configuration.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Accepts a parity-check matrix, failed hard word, posterior LLRs, and `OsdConfig` with documented dimension and NaN validation.
- [hard] REQ-02: Returns $\mathbf{y}\oplus\mathbf{e}$ only when its syndrome is zero, ranking candidates by $\sum_i e_i |L_i|$ with deterministic enumeration-order ties.
- [hard] REQ-03: Selects pivots by ascending posterior magnitude and completes each free-coordinate pattern by back-substitution through the elimination row transform.
- [hard] REQ-04: Order-0 and order-1 results on bounded fixtures match hand-computed back-substitution with the all-zero and single free-coordinate flip patterns.
- [hard] REQ-05: Classifies rank-deficient systems through the row transform and reports a syndrome outside the reachable row space explicitly.
- [hard] REQ-06: Exposes rank, candidate, cap, and termination metadata from the shared reprocessing engine.
- [hard] REQ-07: Matches exhaustive magnitude-cost error search on bounded parity-check fixtures in uncapped configuration for zero, nonzero, rank-deficient, and inconsistent syndromes.

planning.outcome: The syndrome adapter returns the lowest-cost valid tested correction of the failed hard word.

terminal.worker_sized_reason: One public adapter owns error-domain semantics.

title: Published eBCH OSD curve dataset
description:
Commit a machine-readable digitization that pins the selected published eBCH OSD curve plus its source-fixed construction identity.

## Background

The reproduction target is eBCH $(128,64)$ on BI-AWGN/BPSK with BER versus $E_b/N_0$, OSD order 2, with order 1 as a control. The open-access Fossorier 1994 dissertation [Fossorier1994] is the authoritative pinned source: it publishes the same author's algorithm on this code and channel (Figure 4.14 and Tables 4.7–4.9). The [Fossorier1995] article is closed-access and is recorded as bibliographically related but unverified against the digitized material. [Yue2022] supplies an independent near-ML cross-check. The pinned source fixes dimensions, minimum distance, and the per-block systematic convention only; primitive polynomial and field representation are not source-determined.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Identifies the exact pinned-source page, figure, series, construction, channel, metric, and OSD order represented by the digitized data, and records the closed-access, unverified status of the Fossorier1995 article.
- [hard] REQ-02: Records the published reprocessing list order, naming the source's candidate enumeration order and stating where the source leaves tie policy undefined.
- [hard] REQ-03: Records every construction constraint the pinned source fixes — dimensions, minimum distance, and systematic per-block convention — and states explicitly that primitive polynomial and field representation are not source-determined.
- [hard] REQ-04: Stores auditable $E_b/N_0$ plus BER points with digitization method, precision, and provenance.
- [hard] REQ-05: Records the Yue2022 cross-check and material construction, metric, or curve differences without silently reconciling them.
- [hard] REQ-06: Distinguishes the published series from the campaign's order-1 control so the control carries no unsupported external claim.

## Decisions

- DEC-01: No digitized third-party published source in this dataset (the pinned 1994 dissertation and the Yue2022 cross-check alike) reports per-point sample counts, confidence intervals, seeds, RNG identity, producing revision, hardware, toolchain, or invocation for its published results. The dataset records that source silence explicitly per row, receipt, and section; supplying such values is foreclosed as they do not exist in the sources and inventing them is prohibited.
- DEC-02: The per-point uncertainty of every digitized published point is its digitization precision, recorded per row as a declared conservative bound and supported by committed perturbation-sensitivity evidence (marker-center and axis-anchor perturbation); source-side statistical uncertainty is unobtainable per DEC-01.
- DEC-03: The ResearchGate author-uploaded full-text lead for the Fossorier1995 article is resolved as a title-collision false positive: its served attachment is the distinct 1999 IEICE work [Isaka1999]. The article's closed-access, unverified status stands; further acquisition attempts are not required.

planning.outcome: A cited dataset pins the published OSD curve plus the eBCH construction identity.

terminal.worker_sized_reason: One published series receives one provenance review.
